messages.content: Calculate the probability of getting a head when flipping a coin.

function.name: get_standard_deviation

message.content:
For a fair coin (i.e., one that has an equal chance of landing on heads or tails), the probability of getting a head on a single flip is:

\[
P(\text{Head}) = \frac{\text{Number of favorable outcomes}}{\text{Total number of possible outcomes}} = \frac{1}{2} = 0.5
\]

So there’s a 50 % chance of landing on heads. If the coin were biased, you’d need the bias value to compute the exact probability.
